name: com.nekosune.world-ui-assistant
description: Build VRChat world UI without knowing Unity UI – and learn how it works. Panels, pages and no-code actions; lessons, explain mode and glossary; UI Doctor; 28 templates incl. video player controls, portable menu, hotkeys, store/market with Creator Economy and QR links, keypad, scoreboard, poll, dialogue, map, achievements, avatar board, music player, player list, clock, popups; JSON blueprints. Open via NekoSune → World → UI Assistant.
